migrations.markdownDescription: Carry stores' saved values across a renamed or removed theme setting.

id.description: Unique in the file. Sections and theme tokens read settings.<id>.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Toggle. The template reads `true` or `false`.
Colour picker. The template reads a hex colour.
One of the theme's colour schemes. The template reads the scheme's id.
The theme's colour schemes: a list of schemes with an `id`, `label` and `colors`, described by `fields`.
Custom CSS the merchant writes, up to 64 KB.
A font from the platform's font library or the store's own fonts. The platform supplies the options.
Number input. The template reads a number.
Slider. Needs `min` and `max`; `step` and `unit` are optional. The template reads a number.
Drop-down. Needs `options`. The template reads the chosen option's `value`.
Single-line text. The template reads text.
Link. The template reads a URL.
type.markdownDescription: The setting type, which decides the editor control.

default.description: The value a new store starts with.

fields.markdownDescription: For `color_scheme_group`: the palette keys every scheme has, each a CSS identifier (`a-z`, `0-9`, `-`, `_`).

max.markdownDescription: For `range` (required) and `number`: the highest value. For `product_list`, `collection_list` and `product_source`: the most items (12 if not set).

unit.markdownDescription: For `range`: the unit shown after the value, such as `px`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Metafield definitions of a blog category.
Metafield definitions of a blog post.
Metafield definitions of a brand.
Metafield definitions of a category.
Metafield definitions of a collection.
Metafield definitions of a customer.
Metafield definitions of a page.
Metafield definitions of a product.
Metafield definitions of the store.
Metafield definitions of a variant.
Metafield definitions of a vendor.
owner.markdownDescription: For `metafield` (required): the resource whose metafield definitions the merchant picks from. Only `metafield` settings take `owner`.

image.markdownDescription: For `point` (required): the id of the `image` setting the point sits on, in the same block or its section. Only `point` settings take `image`.

key.description: The field's key in the object value. Unique in the setting.

required.description: The merchant must fill the field.

max.description: The field's maximum, such as the most characters.

group.description: Set by the platform on font_picker options. Themes do not write it.

editor.markdownDescription: Present on every setting merchants edit. A setting without `editor` is runtime data the host fills, and is not shown to merchants. `label` and `group` can be literal text or keys from `locales/<locale>.schema.json` (`fieldLabel.<label>`, `fieldGroup.<group>`).

label.description: The setting's or block's label in the theme editor.

group.description: The editor group the setting appears in, such as content or settings.

icon.description: For block types: the block's icon in the theme editor.

visibleIf.markdownDescription:
Show the setting in the editor only while another setting of the same section or block has one of `values`, or, with `set`, while it has a value (`true`) or is empty (`false`). Give exactly one of `values` and `set`.

[Documentation](https://dev-docs.tringify.com/themes/section-schema#settings)

setting.description: The id of the other setting.

values.description: The values that show this setting.

set.description: true: show this setting while the other one has a value (an image picked, text entered). false: while it is empty.

then.errorMessage: visible_if takes exactly one of values and set.

migration.markdownDescription: Carries stores' saved values when a theme setting is renamed (`rename_setting`, `from` and `to`) or dropped on purpose (`remove_setting`, `from`).

markdownEnumDescriptions: A setting was renamed in the same scope: `from` to `to`.
A setting was dropped on purpose: `from` only.

setting.patternErrorMessage: A setting id: not blocks, and without dots or brackets.
